market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $150 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: Settlement price of $150 requires WTI to settle ~40% higher than current $107. Even Goldman's high case is $120. World Bank warns of large surge but $150 settlement requires extreme escalation scenario. Probability low; market 0.175 looks slightly high.
